subject: [AMBER] Looking for a force field with ester linkages between protein chains permitted.

messages.author: David Cowburn
messages.body:
Unable to find a standard force field which will accommodate ester linkage of domains..  Also, unable to access the reference in the manuals to
http://selene.princeton.edu/FFPTM/
from p 57 of the AMBER 22 manual.
Any help appreciated.  Thanks
David Cowburn

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Nov 30, 2023, David Cowburn via AMBER wrote:
>
>Unable to find a standard force field which will accommodate ester linkage
>of domains..  Also, unable to access the reference in the manuals to
>
http://selene.princeton.edu/FFPTM/
from p 57 of the AMBER 22 manual.
I don't think there is a "standard" ff for this, but people know how to get
this going.  Can you provide details about the exact chemistry you want?
That is, which amino acids are modified, and what is the ester linkage
chemistry you need to include?  (If you are starting with a PDB entry, give
us the PDB ID.)
...regards...dave case

messages.author: FyD
messages.body:
Dear David,
> Unable to find a standard force field which will accommodate ester
> linkage of domains..
See
https://upjv.q4md-forcefieldtools.org/Tutorial/Tutorial-4.php
https://upjv.q4md-forcefieldtools.org/Tutorial/Tutorial-4.php#SpltV
(an ester linkage is similar to the phosphodiester linkage in nucleic
acids from a charge derivation point of view)
Best Francois
